text.p: Brazilian meat producer Perdigao SA Comercio e Industria announced a restructuring plan in order to improve its operational performance and its relationship with investors.

Under the restructuring plan, which will be submitted to a shareholder meeting, the group will create a holding company to be called Perdigao Holding SA, according to the firm's statement published in Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper Wednesday.
The holding will be the parent company for all of Perdigao's subsidiaries.

The restructuring will begin with the takeover of two units -- Perdigao Agroindustrial and Perdigao Avicola Rio Claro -- by Perdigao SA Comercio e Industria, which, in turn, will be incorporated by Perdigao Holding SA, it said.
Perdigao SA Comercio e Industria is now the group's only publicly traded company.
It also said it has already sent a request to Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to delist Perdigao SA Comercio e Industria and list the new holding company on the bolsa.
